name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio: Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport was unconventional, beginning with a small Korean bistro he owned near a local karting track. He initially supplied meals for the teams, quickly becoming known for his exceptional bibimbap and kimchi jjigae. His reputation for reliability and quality led to an offer from a junior formula team and eventually to Team WRT. Park prides himself on providing nutritious and culturally diverse meals to the team, understanding the crucial role diet plays in performance. He meticulously plans menus, considering individual dietary needs and preferences, ensuring everyone is fueled for success. His dedication to quality and team well-being sets him apart.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium build with a kind smile.

quirks: Always carries a small jar of homemade gochujang.
Insists on taste-testing every dish, even if it's something he's made hundreds of times.
Refers to the team members as his 'racing family'.
